help.title: Client Help Desk
body: Find a specialist, pick a free time and press “Lock Selected Slot”. The specialist confirms the booking and you see it in “My Bookings” and in the notifications.
You can reschedule or cancel an active booking yourself in “My Bookings”, add it to your calendar and, after the visit, leave a review.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
body: You can cancel or move a pending or confirmed booking at any time before the visit, free of charge, in “My Bookings”.
Please cancel as early as possible so another client can take the time. Specialists can also cancel; you will see it in the notifications.

mobile.title: Mobile Application
body: Navbat works as an app on your phone: install it from the browser and open it from the home screen, full screen and fast.
mobile.installed: The app is installed on this device.
mobile.manual: In your browser menu choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

about.title: About Navbat
body: Navbat (“queue” in Tajik) is online booking for any service in Tajikistan: doctors, barbers, lawyers, car care, driving instructors and tutors.
Clients see real free time and book in seconds. Specialists get a simple schedule, reminders and reviews.

privacy.title: Security & Privacy
body: We store only what is needed for booking: your username, name, phone and your bookings. Passwords are stored encrypted.
Your phone number is shown only to the specialist you booked. We do not sell or share your data.

terms.title: Terms of Service
body: By booking you agree to come on time or cancel in advance. Prices are set by the specialists and paid on the spot in cash or by card.
Reviews must be honest and polite. Navbat may remove accounts that abuse the service.

contact.title: Contact Support
body: Questions, problems or ideas? Write to us — we answer every message.

sync.title: Calendar Sync Tools
body: Specialists get a private calendar link in the partner dashboard (Profile tab). Add it to Google, Apple or Outlook calendar and every booking appears there automatically.
Clients can add any booking to their calendar with the calendar button in “My Bookings”.
